definition: Resisting AI: An Anti-fascist Approach to Artificial Intelligence is a book on artificial intelligence (AI) by Dan McQuillan, published in 2022 by Bristol University Press..
details: Resisting AI: An Anti-fascist Approach to Artificial Intelligence is a book on artificial intelligence (AI) by Dan McQuillan, published in 2022 by Bristol University Press.

explainer.lead: Resisting AI: An Anti-fascist Approach to Artificial Intelligence is a 2022 book by Dan McQuillan. It argues about AI from an explicitly political, anti-fascist standpoint.

tiers.eli5: It is a book that looks at artificial intelligence through a political lens and argues for a particular stance against it.
tiers.practitioner: It is a work of critique rather than an engineering method, so it is cited in discussions of AI ethics and politics. A pitfall is treating a normative book as a technical specification.
tiers.paperLevel: A book on artificial intelligence by Dan McQuillan, published in 2022 by Bristol University Press. The term as defined names a publication, not a formal method.

explainer.example: Someone studying critiques of AI cites the 2022 Bristol University Press book by Dan McQuillan.
